related.title: OpenAPI：契約演進與相容性矩陣
related.titleEn: OpenAPI: contract evolution and compatibility matrices
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 activity-attempts.csv、扣款總帳與回覆遺失反例。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver activity-attempts.csv,debit ledger and lost-reply counterexample.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 建立operationId×scenario矩陣並驗證status與schema；對POST新增required=locale，證明舊請求缺locale被拒絕。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: Build an operationId-by-scenario matrix and validate status/schema;add required locale to POST and show old requests fail. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 6*100 = 600 credit-units；對照 3*100 = 300 credit-units。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
以operation id建立已完成結果表；所有重試回覆原結果，不新增扣款，總額300。

基準 4*3 = 12 contract-cases；對照 4*4 = 16 contract-cases。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
建立operationId×scenario矩陣並驗證status與schema；對POST新增required=locale，證明舊請求缺locale被拒絕。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline 6*100 = 600 credit-units; comparison 3*100 = 300 credit-units. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Store completed results by operation ID;retries return the prior result without another debit,total300.

Baseline 4*3 = 12 contract-cases; comparison 4*4 = 16 contract-cases. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Build an operationId-by-scenario matrix and validate status/schema;add required locale to POST and show old requests fail.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: POSIX 權限：模式位元與 umask
related.titleEn: POSIX permissions: mode bits and umask
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 activity-attempts.csv、扣款總帳與回覆遺失反例。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver activity-attempts.csv,debit ledger and lost-reply counterexample.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 把三組rwx拆成九個位元並逐位套用遮罩；核對644的十進位值420及755的493。
related.differenceEn: Expand rwx into nine bits and apply the mask bitwise, checking decimal420 for0644 and493 for0755.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 6*100 = 600 credit-units；對照 3*100 = 300 credit-units。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
以operation id建立已完成結果表；所有重試回覆原結果，不新增扣款，總額300。

建立時權限是請求模式與遮罩的位元運算，不是十進位相減；檔案與目錄需要不同 execute 語意。
本課數值核對：6*64+4*8+4 = 420 decimal_mode；另一項核對：7*64+5*8+5 = 493 decimal_mode。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline 6*100 = 600 credit-units; comparison 3*100 = 300 credit-units. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Store completed results by operation ID;retries return the prior result without another debit,total300.

Creation permissions use a bit mask, not decimal subtraction; execute has different meanings for files and directories.
Numeric audit: 6*64+4*8+4 = 420 decimal_mode; second audit: 7*64+5*8+5 = 493 decimal_mode. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
